tasks.request: Recolor the existing hit effect to teal #55bbaa. Preserve geometry, timing, alpha, and deterministic output exactly. Keep the same public API. Inspect the result; do not redesign.

Create a 0.6 second impact cue for the supplied paper-garden scene. It marks an authoritative seed landing. Match the scene: flat ink outlines, muted sage/ochre, asymmetric leaf shards, no neon/glow/white flash/camera shake. At 64px display size it should read as a brief landing puff, not a radial sci-fi ring. Keep transparent background and finish cleanly. Reuse the drawEffect API, export duration=0.6 and loop=false.

Replace the one-shot with a seamless 1.2 second ambient ember loop using the same drawEffect API (duration=1.2, loop=true). Use five softly rising ochre embers on transparent background, bounded inside 256x256. The loop seam must be continuous, seeking deterministic; it must stay active after several periods. Reduced motion must show a stable static cue.

Adapt the existing pending/confirmed effect for reduced motion. Both states must remain distinguishable without color: pending is provisional, confirmed communicates success. With reducedMotion=true, remove expansion/translation/pulsing while retaining a static meaningful cue throughout the 0.8s lifetime. Normal motion may remain. Keep transparent background and lifecycle, no success cue for pending.

Harden sheet_effect.gd for local JSON edited by artists. Keep valid impact/slash/embers imports, timing, loop and pivot. Reject malformed structures, wrong numeric types, missing keys, absurd/nonfinite pivots and duration mismatches by returning false without script errors. A failed reconfigure must preserve the previously configured resource, offset, duration, loop and ongoing playback. Set a documented pivot contract. Modify only sheet_effect.gd; add your own checks if useful. Use installed Godot for actual verification.

Adapt ImpactEvents in event-impact.mjs to this game contract: pending display expires after 0.8s; the first authoritative confirmation arriving even after preview expiry MUST display a fresh full 0.8s confirmed phase exactly once. Subsequent confirmed corrections move the cue without restarting it or bursting again. Rejection, finish of a confirmed phase, disposal and round change are terminal. A completion token captured during pending must not close its confirmed replacement. Retain deduplication until round teardown. Validate IDs/rounds (nonempty strings <=128 chars or safe integers), revisions, coordinates before mutation. Bound active/history resources with configurable maxActive/maxHistory, defaults128/4096; on saturation omit new visuals without evicting old deduplication records. Preserve gameplay authority; this adapter owns only presentation. Keep public methods receive, advance, snapshot, completionToken, finish, nextRound, dispose and public active/history/bursts.

limits: One run per arm/task. Shared host, instruction-based file isolation. Not statistically powered or a human preference study.
